# RANDOM.ORG

> RANDOM.ORG is a true random number generation service providing genuine randomness for games, utilities, and applications through atmospheric noise.

RANDOM.ORG offers a comprehensive suite of free online tools for generating true random numbers, sequences, and selections. The service uses atmospheric noise as an entropy source to provide cryptographically sound randomness for lottery picks, games, data generation, and security applications.

## Key Topics

- True Random Number Generation
- Atmospheric Noise Entropy
- Random Integer Generator
- Lottery Quick Pick
- Dice Roller
- Coin Flipper
- Password Generator
- List Randomizer
- Gaussian Distribution
- Playing Card Shuffler
- Random Sequences
- Keno Quick Pick
- Web-based Utility
- Randomization Service
- Cryptographic Randomness

## Core Random Generators

- [Integer Generator](https://www.random.org/integers): Random integer generator using true randomness
- [Sequence Generator](https://www.random.org/sequences): Random integer sequence generator with true randomness
- [Integer Set Generator](https://www.random.org/integer-sets): Random integer set generator using true randomness
- [Decimal Fraction Generator](https://www.random.org/decimal-fractions): Random decimal fraction generator with true randomness
- [Gaussian Random Number Generator](https://www.random.org/gaussian-distributions): Gaussian distribution random number generator
- [Byte Generator](https://www.random.org/bytes): Random byte generator for raw data generation
- [String Generator](https://www.random.org/strings): Random text string generator with true randomness

## Games & Lottery Tools

- [Lottery Quick Pick](https://www.random.org/quick-pick): Lottery quick pick tool using true randomness from RANDOM.ORG
- [Keno Quick Pick](https://www.random.org/keno): Keno quick pick tool using true random number generation
- [Dice Roller](https://www.random.org/dice): Dice roller tool using true random number generation
- [Coin Flipper](https://www.random.org/coins): Virtual coin flipper tool based on true randomness
- [Playing Card Shuffler](https://www.random.org/playing-cards): Playing card shuffler and drawer with true randomness
- [Birdie Fund Randomizer](https://www.random.org/birdie-funds): Golf birdie fund randomizer using true random selection

## Data & Text Tools

- [List Randomizer](https://www.random.org/lists): List randomizer and shuffler using true randomness
- [Password Generator](https://www.random.org/passwords): Secure random password generator using true randomness
- [Clock Time Generator](https://www.random.org/clock-times): Random clock time generator utility tool
- [Calendar Date Generator](https://www.random.org/calendar-dates): Random calendar date generator with true randomness

## Specialized Generators

- [Geographic Coordinates](https://www.random.org/geographic-coordinates): Random geographic location picker on the planet
- [Bitmap Generator](https://www.random.org/bitmaps): Random bitmap visualization generator with true randomness
